contentItem.title: 性质与证明：可公度量与中项无理线段与线段
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line commensurable with the side of the sum of two medial areas is the side of the sum of two medial areas.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line commensurable with the side of the sum of two medial areas is the side of the sum of two medial areas.
直线可公度, 加上两个中项无理线段区域之和,是两个中项无理线段区域之和的一面。（相关点与线段：A）
Let AB be the side of the sum of two medial areas, and CD commensurable with AB; it is to be proved that CD is also the side of the sum of two medial areas.
让AB区域成为两个中项无理线段个区域的总和的一边,CD 可公度个ABAB区域;必须证明,CD区域也是两个中项无理线段个区域的总和的一边。

For, since AB is the side of the sum of two medial areas, let it be divided into its straight lines at E; therefore AE, EB are straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on them medial, the rectangle contained by them medial, and furthermore the sum of the squares on AE, EB incommensurable with the rectangle AE, EB. [[X. 41](/principles/euclid-10-41)]
因为AB是两个中项无理线段个区域之和的一边,所以将其分为E直线;因此,正方形的AE,EB是正方形个直线,中项无理线段的正方形个直线,中项无理线段的矩形个直线,矩形个直线,矩形个直线,AE,AB直线,正方形个直线,矩形,EB直线,EB直线；上述对应量不可公度。 [[X. 41](/principles/euclid-10-41)]
Let the same construction be made as before.

We can then prove similarly that CF, FD are also incommensurable in square, the sum of the squares on AE, EB is commensurable with the sum of the squares on CF, FD, and the rectangle AE, EB with the rectangle CF, FD; so that the sum of the squares on CF, FD is also medial, the rectangle CF, FD is medial, and moreover the sum of the squares on CF, FD is incommensurable with the rectangle CF, FD.
之后,我们可以证明,CF,FD也是正方形,中项无理线段,EB,正方形,不可公度,FD,正方形,不可公度,FD,矩形,AE,矩形,CF,FD,不可公度,中项无理线段,矩形,CF,中项无理线段,正方形,CF,FD,不可公度,不可公度,FD,不可公度,FD,不可公度,FD,不可公度,CF,FD,不可公度,中项无理线段。
Therefore CD is the side of the sum of two medial areas. Q. E. D.
因此,2 中项无理线段个地区总数中只有CD。 证毕。地区。
